verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM explicitly markets running entirely on-device with no accounts/API keys/token limits, and community reports corroborate local use via Ollama and llama.cpp-backed wrappers with fully offline operation. Dev also clarified private/local defaults with opt-in cloud usage, reinforcing local-first architecture.  Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming LM Studio and vLLM as supported backends, and independent benchmarking of full offline parity across all four backends.
